**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.


* Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy

* Obtain 360\-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early\-stage to seasoned leader

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


As a Platform Developer, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for developing, maintaining, and evolving HARMAN’s enterprise AI platform capabilities. You will build and support platform services, frameworks, and integrations that enable the scalable deployment of AI applications, agents, and workflows across the organization. This role requires strong expertise in cloud platforms, platform engineering, security, and production AI operations to ensure platform reliability, scalability, and governance. You will work closely with architects, product owners, and engineering teams to deliver robust platform capabilities that accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
  

  

**Your Team**


You will be a senior individual contributor collaborating with AI architects, platform engineers, product owners, security teams, data engineers, and application developers to build, operate, and continuously improve HARMAN’s enterprise AI platform ecosystem.
  

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**


* Implement and support MLOps and LLMOps processes, including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, lifecycle management, and operational governance.
* Ensure platform solutions meet enterprise requirements for security, scalability, reliability, observability, and performance.
* Collaborate with data, security, and architecture teams to implement governance controls, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Monitor platform health, troubleshoot production issues, optimize performance, and drive continuous operational improvements.
* Contribute to platform documentation, technical standards, reusable assets, and engineering best practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend enhancements that improve platform capabilities and developer experience.
* Develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise AI platform components, services, APIs, and integrations that support AI applications and agent\-based solutions.
* Execute platform architecture designs and implement reusable platform capabilities aligned with enterprise standards and reference architectures.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and deployment processes supporting AI workloads and platform services.
* Perform testing, validation, and operational readiness assessments for platform modules, services, and integrations.
**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, with 6\+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, software engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience developing and operating cloud\-native platforms using Microsoft Azure, AWS, or similar enterprise cloud environments.
* Hands\-on experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, and production deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of platform security, identity and access management, observability, monitoring, and security\-by\-design principles.
* Knowledge of data governance, enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and scalable platform architectures supporting AI and data\-driven solutions.
**Bonus Points if You Have**


* Experience supporting enterprise AI platforms, agent\-based systems, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or generative AI workloads.
* Certifications in Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, DevOps, Security, or related cloud technologies.
* Experience with vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, model serving platforms, and modern AI development ecosystems.
* Experience working in large, global organizations with distributed engineering and operations teams.
**Things To Know**


* Be willing to travel up to 25%, domestic onlyOR domestic and international travel.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class HARMAN and Samsung products (JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG and others).
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development
* Work on best\-in\-class emerging technologies and an atmosphere that motivates you to give your best.

jobs.description:
**Job Requisition ID \#**


26WD100960
Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron\-based desktop platform. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

 **Responsibilities**

* **Test automation \- approximately 35%:** Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end\-to\-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
* **CI/CD and build automation \- approximately 30%:** Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows
* **Release qualification and automation \- approximately 20%:** Help automate Windows desktop packaging, code signing, publishing, installation validation, upgrade testing, and release\-candidate qualification
* **Troubleshooting and quality improvement \- approximately 15%:** Investigate build, test, installer, and application failures. Work with software engineers to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and implement or automate solutions
* Review product requirements and user stories to understand test scope, identify quality risks, and contribute to test plans
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
* Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
* Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
* Participate in release\-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
* Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues
* Improve flaky tests and unreliable pipeline stages to increase the quality of developer feedback
* Document build, test, and release procedures so they can be understood and maintained by the broader engineering team
* Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Software development or test automation experience using a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, C\#, Java, or similar
* Experience developing automated tests for software applications
* Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
* Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems
* Understanding of software testing practices including functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing
* Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers and other technical team members
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Windows desktop applications
* Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
* Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
* Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
* Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
* Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application\-startup scenarios
* Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments
* Familiarity with enterprise Windows environments, device\-management systems, corporate proxies, or restricted\-user configurations
* Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

 **The Ideal Candidate**


You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.


You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems, learning unfamiliar tools, asking questions when needed, and working with more experienced engineers on complex issues. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve the reliability of the team's development and release processes.


You also value the benefits of hybrid collaboration and are comfortable working regularly from Autodesk's Sheffield office while partnering with distributed teams across the company.

  

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web\-based products to deliver richer, higher\-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer\-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.


You will join a new cross\-functional platform team working across desktop application engineering, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, and software release.

**This is a hybrid working position based out of Autodesk's Sheffield office.** You will collaborate both in person with colleagues in Sheffield and remotely with engineering and partner teams across Autodesk.

**Learn More**

**About Autodesk**


Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency**


Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. **Belonging**  

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global\-belonging

 **In\-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification**


This role may require in\-person onboarding and/or in\-person ID verification.

Je hebt complexe systemen gebouwd, grote codebases doorgrond en weet hoe software zich ontwikkelt zodra meerdere teams eraan werken. Juist in zulke omgevingen ligt voor jou de uitdaging: structuur aanbrengen, keuzes verbeteren en systemen toekomstbestendig maken.

Bij ChipSoft zoeken we senior developers die hun ervaring inzetten om onze zorgsoftware structureel beter te maken — niet alleen om deze draaiende te houden.

We bouwen aan het Elektronisch Patiënten Dossier (EPD): software die dagelijks in ziekenhuizen wordt gebruikt en waarin nieuwe functionaliteit altijd samenkomt met bestaande complexiteit.

Binnen R&D werk je aan uiteenlopende technische vraagstukken: van EPD-doorontwikkeling en complexe domeinlogica tot afhankelijkheden die vragen om doordachte ontwerpkeuzes.

Ook data speelt een steeds grotere rol, bijvoorbeeld in analytische toepassingen, gebruiksinzichten, datawarehousing, modellering en AI-ondersteunde oplossingen.

Daarnaast zijn hosting, performance, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid onderdeel van het dagelijkse werk. De software moet stabiel draaien in omgevingen waar uitval geen optie is.

Je helpt ook onze manier van ontwikkelen verbeteren: tooling, processen, samenwerking en technische keuzes moeten meegroeien met een grote R&D-organisatie.

We zoeken developers die al op seniorniveau werken: mensen die grotere systemen overzien, complexiteit beheersbaar maken en rust brengen in technische keuzes.

Je voegt nieuwe perspectieven toe, scherpt keuzes aan en helpt bestaande oplossingen verder te verbeteren.

Wil je werken aan software waarin productontwikkeling, zorgimpact en technische diepgang samenkomen? Dan is dit een plek waar jouw ervaring echt verschil maakt.

Dit Breng Je Mee

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, waaronder C# en .NET.
Ervaring met grote, bedrijfskritische softwareproducten.
Ervaring met meerdere teams en gedeelde codebases.

Onderzoekende houding en drive om continu te verbeteren.
Je draagt kennis over en geeft richting aan technische discussies.

jobs.title: Cloud Software Developer
jobs.description:
Als Cloud Software Developer ga je aan de slag met onze SaaS-dienst Zorgplatform, onze oplossing voor samenwerking en gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg. Voor de ontwikkeling hiervan gebruiken wij Microsoft-technologie. Zie jij dit als een uitdaging? Lees dan verder!

Jouw baan

Als Cloud Software Developer ga je werken aan Zorgplatform, een veilig API-platform dat is gebaseerd op open standaarden. Zorgplatform biedt uitgebreide ondersteuning voor samenwerking tussen zorginstellingen en met patiënten.

Je gaat aan de slag met (inter)nationale initiatieven en standaarden, zodat zorginstellingen op een goede manier gegevens kunnen uitwisselen via Zorgplatform. Wij ontwikkelen dit in C# en .NET 10. Het up-to-date houden van de gebruikte techniek vinden we erg belangrijk.

Je verzorgt bijvoorbeeld de integratie met andere systemen op basis van het Twiin-afsprakenstelsel, je koppelt aan toestemmingsvoorziening Mitz of je bouwt software die voldoet aan (inter)nationale kwalificaties, zoals van MedMij. Dit is dé Nederlandse standaard voor het veilig uitwisselen van gezondheidsgegevens tussen zorggebruikers en zorgaanbieders. Hiermee zorg jij voor digitale ondersteuning van patiëntverwijzingen, dat zorgverleners elkaars patiënten kunnen consulteren en bij elkaar kunnen meekijken en dat patiënten hun gegevens kunnen delen met alle andere gekwalificeerde zorgsystemen in Nederland en internationaal.

Jouw team

Je komt in een team met veel ervaring op het gebied van software development. Het team bestaat uit 15 personen die voornamelijk werken vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam. Naast ontwikkelaars werk je met een aantal consultants die het contact met de klanten onderhouden en het team ondersteunen. Iedere maand vindt er in Amsterdam een Zorgplatform-dag plaats, waarbij jullie elke keer verschillende onderwerpen bespreken die met de ontwikkeling van Zorgplatform te maken hebben.

Je begint de dag met een stand-up met je team. Jij vertelt dat je vandaag een eerste uitwerking van de door jouw bedachte oplossingsrichting wil maken. Je kan goed zelfstandig werken, maar bent ook een echte teamspeler

jobs.title: Gametech Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

The Gametech Innovation team
is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.

As a Mid-Level Developer
within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What it means on a daily basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What success will look like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who you would be working with

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview: A conversation to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test: You will receive a short case study to complete.
Second interview: You will meet members of our technical team to present your test and talk through your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview: You will meet a Hiring Manager to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.
